column1: # note: The 2025 Maryland tax computation worksheet schedules (17A), for taxable net income of $100,000 or more. Each row reads "at least" one dollar above over; the first row of each also holds $100,000, which the heading sends to the schedules.
# note: Each row figures tax as (a) less the subtraction amount (b), times the multiplication amount (d), plus the addition amount (f): base_tax is (f), rate is (d) and of_excess_over is (b).

# note: Schedule I covers single, married filing separately and dependent taxpayers; Schedule II covers married filing jointly, head of household and qualifying surviving spouse. Each is repeated for every status it covers. A dependent taxpayer has no column here.

# note: Schedule I's fifth row prints "At least $250,001 but not over $1,000,000"; its subtraction amount of $500,000 and the row above, which ends at $500,000, show it starts above $500,000, and it is written so.
# note: The schedules cover only the state tax on line 21, not the local tax on line 28.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
